register_model_with_decorator: use the registry.register_model decorator to register a new model class under a unique name key
register_dataset_with_decorator: use the registry.register_dataset decorator to register a new dataset class under a unique name key
get_model_class_by_name: call registry.get_model_class with a name or fully qualified import path to retrieve a registered model class
register_arbitrary_state: call registry.register with a dotted key path and value to store arbitrary data in the registry state
get_registry_value: call registry.get with a dotted key name and optional default to retrieve a value from the registry state
